title: Splicing a prescribed differential and comparison into a lower-supported complex
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ an additive functor, $C,E$ integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $q:F(C)\to E$ a morphism. Let $n$ be an integer and assume $C^i$ is zero for every $i<n$. Given $M\in\mathcal A$, a map $d:M\to C^n$ with $dd_C^n=0$ and $M\to C^n\to C^{n+1}$ exact, an isomorphism $e:F(M)\cong E^{n-1}$, and $F(d)q^n=e d_E^{n-1}$, there exist a cochain complex $D$, a morphism $f:C\to D$ and $q':F(D)\to E$. Their properties are: $D^{n-1}=M$ and $D^i=C^i$ for every other $i$; $f^i$ is an isomorphism for $i\ge n$; $F(f)q'=q$; $(q')^{n-1}$ is an isomorphism; for $i\ge n$, if $q^i$ is an isomorphism then $(q')^i$ is one; $D$ is exact at $n$; and for every $i>n$, exactness of $C$ at $i$ implies exactness of $D$ at $i$.

proof.text: Set k=n-1 and replace only C^k by M. Use the prescribed differential out of M and zero into it; transport every other old differential along the term equalities. CochainComplex.of constructs D. The square-zero equation is the supplied equation in degree k, the old equation elsewhere, or a composite with zero.

Construct f with zero component at k and identity transports elsewhere, using ofHom. The lower support makes its special commutative squares automatic. Construct q' with e at k and transported q components elsewhere. The supplied square proves commutativity at k, the preceding square has zero source, and all other squares are those of q. Verify F(f)q'=q degreewise, and infer the comparison and inclusion isomorphisms from their component formulas.

Apply exactAt_iff' and transport exactness at n through an explicit ShortComplex.isoMk from the three changed terms to M -> C^n -> C^(n+1). For i>n construct an isomorphism between the old and new three-term short complexes; exact_iff_of_iso transfers exactness. The term formula is definitional.

theorem exists_spliceIncomingDifferential
    {A : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} A] [Abelian A]
    {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive]
    (C : CochainComplex A ℤ) (E : CochainComplex B ℤ)
    (q : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C ⟶ E)
    (n : ℤ) (hlower : C.IsStrictlyGE n)
    (M : A) (d : M ⟶ C.X n) (hd : d ≫ C.d n (n + 1) = 0)
    (hexact : (ShortComplex.mk d (C.d n (n + 1)) hd).Exact)
    (e : F.obj M ≅ E.X (n - 1))
    (hcomm : F.map d ≫ q.f n = e.hom ≫ E.d (n - 1) n) :
    ∃ D : CochainComplex A ℤ,
      ∃ f : C ⟶ D,
        ∃ q' : (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D ⟶ E,
          (∀ i, D.X i = if i = n - 1 then M else C.X i) ∧
          (∀ i, n ≤ i → IsIso (f.f i)) ∧
          (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map f ≫ q' = q ∧
          IsIso (q'.f (n - 1)) ∧
          (∀ i, n ≤ i → IsIso (q.f i) → IsIso (q'.f i)) ∧
          D.ExactAt n ∧
          (∀ i, n < i → C.ExactAt i → D.ExactAt i)
